phase: slice 1 library pushed; tests and session-consumer example in progress

commits.subject: Session slice 1: open (package -> folio snapshot), revision-checked submit of chronicle-prepared transactions, atomic save, enumerable instance-owned provider registry, one Observe report per operation

capabilities_done: Session::open_path / open_bytes: bounded PackageReader stream -> folio Snapshot, assets held for re-save, unknown entries kept verbatim, read-only documents refused, per-property revision vector seeded at 0

Session::submit(provider, params, expected_revision, cancel): provider proposes a chronicle Prepared on the immutable snapshot; session re-checks document id, revision (stale -> stale_revision), exactly +1 successor, property revision vector; publishes atomically or not at all
Session::save / save_to: package write -> save_atomic -> re-read destination manifest (revision + document id); codec inherited from opened package; previews dropped and counted
ProviderRegistry: instance-owned, sorted enumeration (ids/list), validated ids, duplicate/full refusal, built-in chronicle.patch provider; no global state
Cancellation via accord CancellationToken at entry, in provider, before commit; budgets = package Limits + chronicle Budget (folio inside)
One Observe terminal frame per operation (open, submit, save); fresh token for the report so a post-commit cancel cannot recast a committed edit
dep_requests: builders/dep-requests.jsonl: serde_json 1.0.151 (dev) for tests/example; all runtime deps are allowed path edges (accord, folio, chronicle, package, observe); no new crates.io runtime dependency
known_gaps: brief ports not in this slice: GrantPort / CommitPort / JobPort, idempotency keys + receipts, reconcile, shutdown drain (next slice)
assets are held in memory after open (package Opened); lazy PackageReader::read_asset is a later slice
previews are dropped on save (derived data describing the pre-edit document) and counted in SaveReceipt
